crossRefs.note: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!
Solomon stood before Yahweh’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward…
The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

translations.web: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
translations.bsb: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
translations.kjv: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
translations.asv: So will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
